nuggets.text: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley played wide receiver at Siena before starting his coaching career at WPI in 2001.
The Dolphins hired both their coach and GM from Green Bay: Jeff Hafley and Jon-Eric Sullivan.
Jeff Hafley says his first deep breath as an NFL head coach will likely come during the national anthem.
The 1972 Dolphins went 17-0, still the only perfect season in NFL history.
Tom Landry dubbed the 1972 Dolphins defense the No-Name Defense for its lack of big-name stars.
The Dolphins ended the 1985 Bears' bid for an unbeaten season on Monday Night Football.
De'Von Achane led the NFL with 40 runs of 10 or more yards last season.
Before the NFL, De'Von Achane sprinted for Texas A&M's track team and ran the 100 meters in 10.02 seconds.
Dolphins quarterback Malik Willis often ends his social media posts with TGFE, short for Thank God for Everything.
Dolphins quarterback Brady Cook won SEC Scholar-Athlete of the Year twice, joining Tim Tebow and Barrett Jones.
